data.introduce:
KX-084 MetalMare
A heavy assault ST developed by Kamadar.
Equipped with an SAT-1 gas guidance system made from Arashium alloy, it converts a portion of the engine's power into kinetic energy for the firearm, enhancing the lethality of each shot. With a simple, stable design, it serves as an NDF-certified mobile turret.
